title: The Ledger of Vanishing Rain
setting_summary: In the sealed city of Kaltbrunn, rain falls only on the rooftops of government buildings while the outer districts parch under a permanent drought. A bureaucratic Ministry of Hydration assigns every citizen a daily water ration and records their words in a public ledger, so that speech and thirst are measured by the same hand. When a young cartographer discovers that the rain's path can be redrawn, she becomes the center of a quiet rebellion that tests dignity, equality, and the right to life itself.
